                                        Table "public.orders"
   Column   |           Type           | Collation | Nullable |              Default
------------+--------------------------+-----------+----------+------------------------------------
 id         | bigint                   |           | not null | nextval('orders_id_seq'::regclass)
 customer   | text                     |           | not null | 
 status     | text                     |           | not null | 'pending'::text
 total      | numeric(12,2)            |           | not null | 0
 currency   | character(3)             |           | not null | 'EUR'::bpchar
 created_at | timestamp with time zone |           | not null | now()
 updated_at | timestamp with time zone |           |          | 
Indexes:
    "orders_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (id)
    "orders_customer_idx" btree (customer)
    "orders_status_created_idx" btree (status, created_at)
Foreign-key constraints:
    "orders_customer_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (customer) REFERENCES customers(id)
